title: quercus × komarovii
intro: Quercus × komarovii, commonly known as the Komarov oak, is a hybrid plant species derived from the cross between Quercus acutissima and Quercus dentata. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which contribute to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Quercus × komarovii include its potential to lower cholesterol levels, reduce blood pressure, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which have been shown to possess antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
